items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: So, then we had another -- they had a girl and her name was Gertie Waters. She could read all the music... Then we had a fellow, his name was Freddie Blackburn... Jacques can lead the band.

ctx.x: Very polite man. He'd married/and his a French family family -- so, we, I'm happy about this offering.
And I met a fellow, his name was Bill Kurzie. A very quiet person, nice, talk real slow. It would take him two hours to say hello, too.
